name: bolt.diy
what: The open-source version of Bolt: an AI workspace where you prompt, run, edit and deploy full-stack web apps in the browser. You choose the LLM for each prompt from 22+ providers, including local models through Ollama or LM Studio. MIT licensed; the WebContainers API it uses has separate commercial terms for enterprise use.
who: Vibe coders who want a Bolt-style app builder they run themselves, with their own API keys or local models.

setup.text: Needs Node.js 22.12+ and pnpm 9.15.9+. Clone and install:
setup.code:
git clone https://github.com/stackblitz-labs/bolt.diy.git
cd bolt.diy
pnpm install

setup.text: Add provider keys in Settings → Providers (or in .env.local). Prebuilt desktop apps and Docker setups are in the README.

prompts: Build a habit tracker with a calendar view and local storage.
Make a landing page for my indie game with a mailing list signup form.
Add a dark mode toggle and make the layout work on mobile.
